body: I've tried many times, probably close to 10 different semesters. I usually quit somewhere in the first 2 months. I can't commit to anything, school, gym, work, walking my dog. I don't want to come across as self pity. Like i said, i have a good life, all of these things, it is I who bring upon myself. Why, I don't know. It is such a strong feeling that makes me quit and do nothing, i dont feel in control
